title: 锦标赛起步与F2规则例外
summary: 1950–51年，Alfa Romeo的小排量机械增压发动机与Ferrari大排量自然吸气路线竞争。1952–53年的世界锦标赛大奖赛转用F2规则，印第安纳波利斯500除外，不能把四年画成一套不变的F1发动机规格。
en_title: The championship begins, then uses F2 rules
en_summary: In 1950–51, Alfa Romeo’s smaller supercharged engine competed with Ferrari’s larger naturally aspirated approach. Championship Grands Prix in 1952–53 ran to Formula 2 rules, apart from the Indianapolis 500; the four years do not share one unchanged F1 engine formula.

sources.title: Formula 1 — Under the bodywork of the Alfa Romeo Alfetta
Formula 1 — Six combinations of dominant drivers and cars

title: 2.5升自然吸气时期
summary: 1954年新规则确立2.5升自然吸气路线。这个时期也经历从前置发动机向中置发动机的布局转变；发动机安装位置与气缸排列、排量属于不同维度。
en_summary: New rules in 1954 established the 2.5-litre naturally aspirated formula. The period also saw the move from front to mid-mounted engines; installation position is separate from cylinder layout and displacement.

sources.title: Formula 1 — Why Aston Martin’s first F1 entry was one to forget

title: 1.5升小排量公式
summary: 自然吸气排量上限由2.5升降至1.5升。规则缩小发动机容量，也重新分配各车队的准备优势；不能把这一时期与1970–80年代的涡轮规则混为一谈。
en_summary: The naturally aspirated capacity limit fell from 2.5 to 1.5 litres. This changed development priorities and rewarded teams prepared for the new formula. It is distinct from the later turbo era.

sources.title: Formula 1 — Key regulation changes and the teams that nailed them

title: 3.0升时代与DFV
summary: 1966年自然吸气排量上限升至3.0升。1967年Cosworth DFV随Lotus 49在荷兰大奖赛首秀夺冠，随后成为多支车队采用的重要V8机型。
en_summary: The naturally aspirated limit rose to 3.0 litres in 1966. The Cosworth DFV won on its debut in the Lotus 49 at the 1967 Dutch Grand Prix and became a major engine for multiple teams. The formula and the engine model are separate layers of the story.

sources.title: Cosworth — Six decades of heritage at Goodwood Revival
McLaren — Why does Formula 1 change its regulations?

title: 涡轮增压重塑竞争
summary: Renault在1977年带入涡轮增压路线。它与既有自然吸气发动机共存并逐步改变竞争格局，直到1988年结束后涡轮被禁。这一时期把增压、燃油使用和可靠性的权衡推到赛车开发中心。
en_summary: Renault introduced turbocharging in 1977. Turbo engines initially coexisted with naturally aspirated competitors and reshaped the field before the ban took effect in 1989. This is a distinct period between the DFV’s rise and the later naturally aspirated rules.

sources.title: Formula 1 — Key regulation changes and the teams that nailed them

title: 3.5升自然吸气回归
summary: 1989年涡轮禁令生效，3.5升自然吸气成为主线。Honda的V10是新规则下的代表，说明发动机时代不宜简单等同于某一种气缸数量。
en_summary: The turbo ban took effect in 1989 and the 3.5-litre naturally aspirated formula took over. Honda’s V10 was a prominent example, showing why an engine era should not be reduced to a single cylinder count.

sources.title: Formula 1 — Reigning champions after regulation changes

title: 排量降至3.0升
summary: 1995年排量上限由3.5升降至3.0升，直到2006年主规则改为2.4升V8。相同的3.0升排量上限，在1960年代和1990年代对应不同的技术发展阶段。
en_summary: The capacity limit fell from 3.5 to 3.0 litres in 1995, before the main formula changed to a 2.4-litre V8 in 2006. The same 3.0-litre capacity limit belonged to different stages of engine development in the 1960s and 1990s.

title: 2.4升V8与KERS
summary: 2006年主规则转为2.4升V8。KERS在2009年进入F1，把制动阶段可回收的能量用于之后的助力；系统采用与规则演进有阶段差异，不能写成这八年所有赛车一直使用同一混动配置。
en_summary: The main engine formula changed to a 2.4-litre V8 in 2006. KERS arrived in 2009, recovering energy for later assistance. Adoption evolved, so the entire period should not be portrayed as every car using one unchanged hybrid system.

sources.title: Formula 1 — Key regulation changes and the teams that nailed them
Formula 1 — A pictorial history of Eau Rouge

title: 1.6升V6涡轮混动
summary: 2014年引入1.6升V6涡轮增压动力单元，结合MGU-K与MGU-H的电能管理。发动机、涡轮、电机和能量储存需要一体协调；2026年移除MGU-H，转入下一代规则。
en_summary: The 2014 formula introduced a 1.6-litre turbocharged V6 power unit with MGU-K and MGU-H energy management. Combustion, turbocharging, electrical machines and energy storage became closely integrated. The 2026 architecture without the MGU-H is shown separately.

sources.title: Formula 1 — Key regulation changes and the teams that nailed them

title: 更强电驱与先进可持续燃料
summary: 按FIA 2026技术规则Issue 20及F1官方说明，MGU-H移除，ERS-K绝对直流功率上限为350kW，具体释放仍受工况限制。燃料采用先进可持续燃料要求；C16.3.5允许质量占比不超过1%的非可持续添加剂或变性剂。这是规则摘要，不推断实时比赛表现。
en_title: More electrical power and advanced sustainable fuel
en_summary: FIA 2026 Technical Regulations Issue 20 and the official F1 summary describe removal of the MGU-H and a 350 kW absolute DC power ceiling for ERS-K, with deployment conditions still applying. Advanced sustainable-fuel requirements allow up to 1% by mass of non-sustainable additives or denaturants under C16.3.5. This summarizes rules rather than live race performance.

sources.title: FIA — 2026 F1 Regulations Section C Technical, Issue 20, 5 August 2026
